name: City Council
summary: The Mayor and six council members set city policy, adopt the budget and pass ordinances.
meets: Second and fourth Tuesday, 6 pm, Council Chambers
about: The City Council is the city's elected governing body. Regular meetings are open to the public and streamed live. Anyone can speak during public comment; sign up at the door or online before 5 pm on the day of the meeting.

name: Planning and Zoning Commission
summary: Reviews zoning changes, subdivisions and the comprehensive plan, and advises the Council.
meets: First and third Thursday, 6 pm, Council Chambers
about: The Commission holds public hearings on zoning changes, plats and specific use permits, then sends recommendations to the City Council.

name: Parks and Recreation Board
summary: Advises the Council on parks, trails, pools and recreation programs.
meets: Third Tuesday, 5:30 pm, Falls Park Recreation Center
about: The board reviews park plans, fees and programs and hears from residents about the park system.

name: Library Advisory Board
summary: Advises on library services, policies and the collection.
about: The board advises the Library Director and the Council on library policy and services.

name: Utility Commission
summary: Reviews water and wastewater rates, capital projects and conservation.
meets: First Monday, 5:30 pm, City Hall Room 204
about: The Commission reviews utility rates and major water projects before they go to the City Council.

name: Board of Adjustment
summary: Hears requests for variances from the zoning ordinance.
meets: Fourth Monday as needed, 5:30 pm, Council Chambers
about: The Board of Adjustment decides requests for variances and appeals of zoning decisions.
